43868.11.t: When you are the one who is sick
43868.11.x: Lord, I am sick, and I am tired of being sick. Heal me, if it is your will, and give me grace to take each day as it comes. “Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise” (Jeremiah 17:14). Amen.
43868.11.a: Short Prayers for the Sick: Words for a Bedside or a Text

41748.2.x: Father, this illness has taken my strength, and some days I can barely get out of bed. Give me patience with my body, courage for each treatment, and enough strength for what today asks of me. Work through the doctors and nurses, and heal me, if it is your will. Amen.
41748.2.a: Prayers for Strength: When You Are Worn Out, Afraid or Tempted

45362.11.x: Lord, I am the one on the list today, and I am afraid of going under and of what the surgeon will find. I put my body and my life in your hands. Guide the people who will care for me, and let me wake with you still beside me. “Fear thou not; for I am with thee” (Isaiah 41:10). Amen.
45362.11.a: Catholic Prayers for Someone Having Surgery: Before, During and After

43830.3.x: Lord, you know this body better than any doctor does, and you know what is wrong with it. Heal what is sick in me, and give back the strength this illness has taken. Let the treatment work, and let the next results be good. Amen.
43830.3.a: Prayers for Healing: Bible Prayers, Church Prayers and Prayers for a Miracle

41748.7.t: When grief has taken your strength
41748.7.x: Lord, since the loss I have had no energy for anything. Carry me through the days I cannot manage. Let me feel joy again in time, for “the joy of the LORD is your strength” (Nehemiah 8:10). Amen.
41748.7.a: Prayers for Strength: When You Are Worn Out, Afraid or Tempted

2165.1.t: Prayer to Endure the Pain of Loss
2165.1.x:
Heavenly Father,

In the shadow of my grief, I reach out to You, seeking Your light to pierce through the darkness enveloping me. Grant me the strength to bear this burden and the resilience to withstand the tempest of my sorrow. Like a tree firmly rooted in the earth, help me to stand strong amidst the storms of life, knowing that with You, I will not be uprooted.

Lord, imbue my spirit with Your peace, so I may face each day with courage and hope. Let Your love be the balm to my aching heart, comforting me in my moments of despair. Illuminate my path with Your eternal presence, guiding me towards healing and acceptance.

In Your wisdom, You understand the intricacies of my pain. Mend what has been broken within me, and renew my spirit, empowering me to carry forward the legacy of love left by those I have lost. Through my journey of grief, let me discover the powerful resilience You’ve planted within my soul.

Amen.
2165.1.a: Consoling Prayers for Grief and Loss: For Anger, Guilt, Memories and Living Again

45206.10.t: Prayer for Finding Hope in the Darkness
45206.10.x:
God of Hope,

The darkness of this grief feels total and overwhelming. I can't see a way forward, and hope feels lost to me. Despair whispers that things will never get better, that this pain will be my reality forever. My heart longs for a glimmer of light, a reason to believe in joy again.

Father, I ask You to be my hope. When I cannot find it myself, please plant a seed of hope deep within my spirit. Remind me of Your promises and of the final victory we have in Jesus. Show me small signs of Your faithfulness and goodness in my everyday life, even if they are tiny.

Help me to look up from my sorrow and fix my eyes on You, the author of my faith. Even though I am weeping now, remind me of the eternal hope that awaits, where there will be no more tears or pain. Let that future hope give me strength for today, In Jesus' Name, Amen.

2243.1.x:
Heavenly Father,

In this valley of shadow and loss, I reach out for Your unwavering hand. Grant me the resilience to stand amidst this storm of grief, to weather these waves of sorrow that threaten to engulf me. Like a tree planted by streams of water, let my roots run deep into the soil of Your love, drawing strength even in the midst of despair.

Lord, as You comforted Mary and Martha in their distress, envelop me now in Your peace. Teach me to walk through this dark valley with faith, not fear, knowing You are with me. Illuminate my path with the light of Your presence, that I may see beyond this temporal pain to the eternal joy that awaits.

Strengthen my heart, O God, that I may bear this burden with grace, and emerge resilient, refined by this trial. May I lean into the comfort of Your promises, and in doing so, become a beacon of hope to others who navigate their own seas of grief.

Amen.
2243.1.a: Prayers for the Loss of a Loved One: 12 Prayers for Comfort and Strength

45467.2.x: God, I am frightened of what tomorrow will bring. Hold me up. “What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee” (Psalm 56:3). I am afraid now, and I choose to trust you now. Amen.
45467.2.a: Prayers for Trusting God in Hard Times, with the Daily Prayer of Philaret of Moscow

3087.3.x: Lord, I am frightened of what is coming. You said, “Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God” (Isaiah 41:10). Stand beside me when the news comes, and give me courage to face it. “What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee” (Psalm 56:3). Amen.
3087.3.a: Prayers for Strength and Comfort in Hard Times

1616.14.t: When anxiety will not let you sleep
1616.14.x: God, my mind will not stop racing. I bring you everything that frightens me, one worry at a time. Let “the peace of God, which passeth all understanding,” keep my heart and mind (Philippians 4:7), and give me rest tonight. Amen.
1616.14.a: Prayers for Calm in a Storm: Bad Weather and the Storms of Life

2057.5.t: When anxiety and fear take over
2057.5.x: Lord, my heart is racing and my thoughts will not stop. I cannot think my way out of this. I cast this care on you, because you care for me (1 Peter 5:7). Slow my breathing, quiet my mind, and give me the peace Jesus promised: “Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid” (John 14:27). Amen.
2057.5.a: Prayers for Emotional Healing: For Hurt, Betrayal, Shame and Sorrow

2021.9.t: When work has become a burden
2021.9.x: Lord, work has become a place of conflict and pressure. Give me patience with the people I find hardest, fairness toward those under me, and honesty when it costs me. You shut the lions’ mouths for Daniel (Daniel 6:22); protect me from those who want me to fail. If it is time to leave, open another door. Amen.
2021.9.a: Prayers in Time of Trouble: For Worry, Despair, Quarrels, Money and Work

45335.10.t: When the worry is about money
45335.10.x: Father, the bills are more than I have this month. Show me the next honest step and send the help I need. Your Son said you know what we need before we ask (Matthew 6:8). Keep me from despair while I work it out. Amen.
45335.10.a: Catholic Prayers for Anxiety, Worry and Fear: The Memorare, St. Michael and Short Prayers

2576.1.x: Father, I am looking for work, and I do not know where it will come from. Show me where to apply and who to ask. Give me the energy to keep at it every day, and the honesty to describe myself truly. “Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established” (Proverbs 16:3). I commit this search to you. Amen.
2576.1.a: Prayers for a New Job: From the First Application to the First Day

45445.4.x: Lord, my job is gone, and with it the paycheck we depended on. Keep me from despair. Open a door to new work, give me energy for every application and every job interview, and remind me that my worth does not come from what I earn. Amen.
45445.4.a: Catholic Prayers for Financial Help, Debt and Money Worries

44703.1.x: God, I have two good options and I keep changing my mind. Neither is sinful, and both could serve you. Help me to weigh them honestly, to notice which one I am only choosing out of fear or pride, and then to choose and stop looking back. Amen.
44703.1.a: Prayers for God's Will: To Know It, Accept It and Follow It

2069.0.x: Lord, I have to choose, and I cannot see the way clearly. Give me wisdom, show me what is right, and close the doors I should not walk through. Give me courage to act, and peace to accept what follows. Not my will, but yours, be done. Amen.
2069.0.a: Prayers for Making the Right Decision: Wisdom, Clarity and Courage to Choose

2108.5.x: Lord, I cannot see which way to go, and every choice looks both right and wrong. Send out your light and your truth, and let them lead me (Psalm 43:3). Make the right way plain, and give me the courage to take it. Amen.
2108.5.a: Prayers for Illumination: Light to Understand Scripture and See Clearly

2066.0.x: Lord, I do not know which way to go. Show me the next right step, give me the sense to see it and the courage to take it, and keep me close to you whatever I choose. Amen.
2066.0.a: Prayers for Direction in Life: For Guidance, Big Decisions and Losing Your Way

2613.1.t: When every conversation turns into a fight
2613.1.x: Lord, we cannot talk about anything without it becoming an argument. Put a guard on my mouth. Give me “a soft answer” that “turneth away wrath” (Proverbs 15:1), and help us both to stop keeping score. Do not let us go to bed angry again: “let not the sun go down upon your wrath” (Ephesians 4:26). Amen.
2613.1.a: Prayers to Restore a Marriage: After Fighting, Betrayal or Separation

1985.2.t: When family members are not speaking
1985.2.x: Lord, the silence in our family has gone on for weeks, and every holiday reminds us of it. Soften the hearts that have closed, starting with mine. Show me whether to write, call or wait, and prepare the other person to hear me when I do. Amen.
1985.2.a: Prayers for Family Problems: Peace, Healing and Keeping a Family Together

2003.7.x: God, we said hard things to each other today. Calm us down before we say more. Show me what I got wrong and give me the humility to say sorry first. Your word says, “A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger” (Proverbs 15:1). Amen.
2003.7.a: Prayers for Your Family: Love, Unity, Peace and Protection

43885.13.x: Father, we hurt each other today, and we both said things we regret. Give me the humility to apologize first and the grace to accept an apology without holding on to the wrong. Teach us to be “kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you” (Ephesians 4:32). Do not let the sun go down on our anger (Ephesians 4:26). Amen.
43885.13.a: Prayers for Family: Short Prayers for Meals, Bedtime, Peace and Hard Times

2138.1.x: God of hope, I have run low on it. I cannot see how this will turn out, and some days I stop expecting it to. Fill me again, as your word says: “Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost” (Romans 15:13). Amen.
2138.1.a: Prayers for Hope and Better Days When Life Is Hard

1991.13.x: Lord, nobody around me seems to understand how I feel. You do. Stay with me, and send me one person I can talk to honestly. “Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means” (2 Thessalonians 3:16). Amen.
1991.13.a: Prayers for Inner Peace and a Calm Mind, with the Serenity Prayer

45471.2.x: God, everything feels heavy and grey, and I cannot remember what it was like to enjoy anything. I ask with the psalmist, “Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me?” Help me to “hope thou in God” even when I feel nothing, and bring me through to a day when I can praise you again (Psalm 42:11). Amen.
45471.2.a: Prayers for Mental Illness: For Yourself, for Someone You Love, and Traditional Prayers for a Troubled Mind

3087.6.t: When you feel alone in it
3087.6.x: God, nobody around me seems to understand what this is like. Remind me that you do. You have said, “I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee” (Hebrews 13:5). Send one person who will sit with me, and let me feel that you are near. Amen.
3087.6.a: Prayers for Strength and Comfort in Hard Times

44698.8.t: When moving to a new city
44698.8.x: Father, I do not know anyone here yet. Lead me to a church, to good neighbors and to at least one friend. You told your exiled people in Babylon, “Build ye houses, and dwell in them,” and “seek the peace of the city” (Jeremiah 29:5, 7). Help me put down roots and seek the good of this place. Amen.
44698.8.a: Prayers for a New Home: A House Blessing, Room by Room, and Prayers for Moving

2066.10.x: Lord, everything is new: the city, the work, the people. You promised, “I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert” (Isaiah 43:19). Make a way for me here, and send me friends who will point me to you. Amen.
2066.10.a: Prayers for Direction in Life: For Guidance, Big Decisions and Losing Your Way

1286.3.x: Lord, tomorrow I start a new job. I do not know the people, the building or the way things are done. Help me learn quickly, ask good questions and make friends. Let me work honestly and do more than the minimum. “Establish thou the work of our hands upon us” (Psalm 90:17). Amen.
1286.3.a: Prayers for New Beginnings: A New Job, a New Home, a New Chapter

2576.8.x: Lord, thank you for this job. Today everything is new: the building, the people, the work. Help me learn quickly, ask good questions, remember names and be kind to the people I meet. “And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us” (Psalm 90:17). Amen.
2576.8.a: Prayers for a New Job: From the First Application to the First Day

1934.9.t: 2. At the end of the day
1934.9.x: Father, thank you for this day: for the work I finished, the food I ate, the people I spoke to, and the troubles you carried me through. Forgive what I did wrong in it. Now I will rest, because “I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety” (Psalm 4:8). Amen.
1934.9.a: Prayers of Thanks to God: 12 Short Prayers of Gratitude and Traditional Thanksgivings

45445.7.x: Thank you, Father, for the check that arrived, the friend who helped, the work that came through. Keep me grateful when things are easier, and make me generous to the next person who is where I was. Amen.
45445.7.a: Catholic Prayers for Financial Help, Debt and Money Worries

44724.9.x:
God of Miracles, I am here to give You praise. I was staring at a wall that felt too high to climb and too thick to break down. I saw no options, no path forward. In my desperation, I asked You to make a way where there was no way.

And You did the impossible. You parted the sea before me. You opened a door that I didn't even know existed. What seemed like a final dead end, You turned into a new beginning. My relief and awe are beyond words. You have shown me that my limited vision is nothing compared to Your unlimited power.

Thank you for proving, once again, that nothing is too difficult for You. This answered prayer has not just changed my circumstances; it has radically boosted my faith. I will walk through this open door with a heart full of gratitude, trusting You to lead me every step of the way, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
44724.9.a: 12 Prayers For Thanking God For Answered Prayers: Simple & Powerful

2507.13.x: Lord, your word tells me to bring my requests to you “with thanksgiving” (Philippians 4:6). Thank you for the things that went well today, for the people who helped me, and for the worries that came to nothing. Amen.
2507.13.a: Prayers to Calm a Worried Mind and Stop Bad Thoughts

45165.3.x: Lord, I am leaving home today. Go before me and behind me. Keep me and everyone traveling with me from harm, watch over the house and the people I leave behind, and bring us together again. “Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way” (Exodus 23:20). Amen.
45165.3.a: Catholic Prayers for Safe Travel: The Itinerarium, Short Prayers and Saints for the Road

44727.8.x: Lord, I am about to drive. Keep my eyes on the road and my mind on my driving. Protect me from my own mistakes and from the mistakes of others, and bring me home. “The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore” (Psalm 121:8). Amen.
44727.8.a: Prayers for a New Car: Buying It, Blessing It and Driving It

44037.0.x: Lord, go with me on this trip. Keep me and everyone traveling with me safe on the way, watch over the people I leave at home, and bring us all back together in peace. Amen.
44037.0.a: Prayers for Travel: Before a Journey, for the Road, a Flight and a Safe Return

1622.4.t: Prayer for Divine Shield and Protection during Travels
1622.4.x:
Heavenly Father,

As I embark on this journey, I place myself under Your mighty wings of protection. Just as You parted the Red Sea for the Israelites, make my path safe and clear. Surround me, Lord, with Your divine shield, keeping me from harm’s reach. May Your angels guard me in all my ways, so that I may tread on unfamiliar grounds with confidence and peace.

In every step, let Your presence be my compass, guiding me through moments of uncertainty. I pray not only for my safety but also for all who share my journey. Keep our minds alert and our bodies unharmed. Bless this voyage, Father, and bring us to our destination and back home again, enveloped in Your unfailing love and protection.

In Jesus’ name, Amen.
1622.4.a: 12 Prayers for God's Favor, Shield, and Keeping

44546.3.t: Prayer for Comfort and Relief from Pain
44546.3.x: O God of all Comfort, You see the pain my child endures. You see the physical discomfort, the frustration, and the emotional distress that they cannot always put into words. My heart breaks to see them suffer. I come to You now, asking for Your merciful touch upon their body and their mind. Lord, please bring relief. Soothe their pain, calm their anxieties, and bring ease where there is struggle. Surround them with a tangible sense of Your loving presence, a deep comfort that goes beyond any medicine. Guide the hands and minds of doctors and therapists. If it is Your will, bring complete healing, but in all things, grant us the grace to endure and the comfort of knowing You are with us, holding my child in the palm of Your hand. In Jesus' Name, Amen.
44546.3.a: 12 Prayers For Disabled Child: Simple & Powerful

45537.20.t: Prayer for Swift Healing When He Is Unwell
45537.20.x:
Lord Jesus, the Great Physician, my son is unwell, and my heart comes to You for help. You have the power to heal all diseases and to make the broken whole. I ask that you would lay Your healing hand upon him right now.

Please touch his body and remove every trace of sickness. Bring comfort to his discomfort, ease his pain, and bring rest to his weary body. I pray that you would work quickly, Lord, for a swift and complete recovery that can only be credited to You.

As he rests, I pray that Your peace would settle over him and our home. Help him to feel Your loving presence near. Strengthen his body hour by hour, and let him rise from this sickness stronger than before. Please restore his energy, his appetite, and his cheerful spirit, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45537.20.a: Prayers for Your Son's Health and Healing

2045.10.t: When a grown daughter is ill
2045.10.x: Lord Jesus, my daughter is sick, and I am not the one caring for her now. Be with her in the appointments and the tests, give her doctors a clear judgment, and let the treatment do its work. Jairus came to you and said, "My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed" (Mark 5:23). I ask the same for mine. Amen.
2045.10.a: Prayers for a Daughter's Well-Being: Her Mind, Health, Safety and Faith

44728.8.t: Prayer for Healing When Baby is Unwell
44728.8.x:
Merciful Healer, we come to you with a heavy heart because our little one is unwell. You see their discomfort and our worry. We ask You to lay your gentle, healing hand upon this child right now.

Lord, we pray that you would touch their body and bring restoration and wholeness. We rebuke this sickness in the name of Jesus and ask that you would command their body to be well. Bring down any fever, soothe any pain, and restore any strength that has been lost. The Bible says in Jeremiah 30:17, "But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds." We hold onto Your promise for our baby.

Please comfort them, Lord. Give them peace even in their distress. Give us, as parents, wisdom to know how to care for them and an unshakeable peace that comes from trusting You. We thank you in advance for the healing we know you are bringing, in Jesus’ Name, Amen.
44728.8.a: 12 Prayers For Baby Health: Simple & Powerful

4121.21.x: Lord, we come to you with heavy hearts, mourning the loss of our beloved child. We ask for your grace and mercy to ease our pain and comfort our broken hearts. Help us remember our child with love and joy, and never forget their impact on our lives. Give us the strength to honor their memory and cherish our time together. Help us to find peace and solace in our pain, and to turn our sadness into joy by remembering the beauty of our child. We know that they are with you now, and that they will remain in our hearts forever. Amen.
4121.21.a: Prayers After Losing a Child: For Grieving Parents and for the Child Who Died

3042.10.x: God, our baby is gone, and the plans we made are gone with it. You are “nigh unto them that are of a broken heart” (Psalm 34:18). Hold our child in your care, heal my body, and carry us through this grief. Do not let us face the next month alone. Amen.
3042.10.a: Prayers for Fertility and Conceiving a Child: Hannah's Prayer, Short Prayers and Saints

45175.3.t: Prayer to Release Feelings of Guilt
45175.3.x:
Merciful Father, my mind is a prison of regret.

The questions haunt me day and night. What if I had done something differently? Could I have prevented this? My heart accuses me, and I am drowning in a sea of guilt and self-blame. This burden is too heavy to carry, and it is crushing my spirit.

Lord, you know every detail. You know my heart and my deep love for my child. I ask You to speak truth into my soul. Help me to separate the lies of the enemy from Your loving reality. Your Word in Romans 8:1 says, "There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus."

I choose to stand on that promise. I release the "what ifs" and "if onlys" into Your hands. Please wash over me with Your grace and forgive me for the ways I failed, whether real or imagined. Free me from this prison of guilt so that I can grieve without this added weight. In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45175.3.a: 12 Prayers For Loss Of Child: Simple & Powerful

4121.6.x: God, when Absalom died, King David cried, “O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee” (2 Samuel 18:33). I understand him now. Give me strength to grieve without hiding it, and to hold up my family while I am falling apart. Amen.
4121.6.a: Prayers After Losing a Child: For Grieving Parents and for the Child Who Died

2045.2.x: Lord, my daughter's mind will not rest. She lies awake going over every worry, and I cannot talk her out of them. Quiet her thoughts. Your word says, "God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind" (2 Timothy 1:7). Give her that sound mind, and sleep tonight. Amen.
2045.2.a: Prayers for a Daughter's Well-Being: Her Mind, Health, Safety and Faith

45233.5.x:
Almighty God, Your perfect love casts out all fear. I bring my child before You and ask that You would fill their heart with supernatural courage. When they face things that make them feel anxious—whether it's a test at school, trying something new, or standing up for what is right—remind them powerfully that You are with them.

Take away any spirit of fear and timidity and replace it with a spirit of power, love, and self-discipline. Let their confidence be found not in their own abilities, but in Your unwavering presence. Help them to be brave enough to be themselves, to speak the truth in love, and to face challenges head-on, knowing You are their defender.

May the declaration, "The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid," be the anthem of their heart. Let them walk through life with a calm and courageous spirit, completely secure in the knowledge that they are held by You. In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45233.5.a: 12 Prayers For A Child: Simple & Powerful

2279.10.x: God, when my son is afraid or pressed to go along with the crowd, give him the courage you gave Joshua: “Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest” (Joshua 1:9). Amen.
2279.10.a: Prayers for Your Son at Every Stage of His Life

44512.25.t: Prayer for His Mental and Emotional Well-being
44512.25.x:
Father of mercies and God of all comfort, I lift up my son's mental and emotional well-being to You. You know the secret burdens he carries and the silent battles he fights in his own mind. Please be his peace in moments of anxiety and his light in seasons of darkness.

Guard his mind against negative thought patterns, despair, and hopelessness. When he feels overwhelmed by the pressures of life, remind him that he can cast all his anxieties on You because You care for him so deeply. Let him feel Your presence in a tangible way.

Lord, I ask that You would heal any emotional wounds from his past and give him the courage to seek help if he needs it. Fill his soul with your peace that passes all understanding and protect his heart and mind in Christ Jesus, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
44512.25.a: Prayers for Your Adult Son: Protection, Work, Family and Faith

45531.7.t: For a good job, the right one for him
45531.7.x: Father, any job would feel like relief right now. I ask you for more: work that fits his skills, pays honestly, and does not ask him to give up his conscience. Give him good managers and coworkers who will teach him. You told your people in exile, “I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end” (Jeremiah 29:11). Lead my son into work that brings him peace. Amen.
45531.7.a: Prayers for Your Son to Find a Job: From the Search to His First Week

2279.4.t: When he is looking for work
2279.4.x: Lord, my son needs work, and each rejection makes him doubt himself. Open a door to a job that uses what he is good at and pays enough to live. Give him courage at interviews and honesty in whatever work he finds, doing it “heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men” (Colossians 3:23). Amen.
2279.4.a: Prayers for Your Son at Every Stage of His Life

2045.17.t: For her work and her future
2045.17.x: Father, my daughter is looking for her place in the world. Open the right door for her work, give her employers who treat her fairly, and help her to do her job "heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men" (Colossians 3:23). Where her plans fail, give her the courage to try again, and let her dreams be the ones you have for her. Amen.
2045.17.a: Prayers for a Daughter's Well-Being: Her Mind, Health, Safety and Faith

44726.7.t: For a son or daughter at work
44726.7.x: Father, my son has work to do and a life to build, and I cannot do it for him. Give him skill and patience, good people to learn from, and a boss who is fair. When he makes mistakes, let him learn from them and not lose heart. Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings. (Proverbs 22:29) Amen.
44726.7.a: Prayers for Success at Work: Before Work, for a Husband or Son, and for Hard Days

45385.14.x: God, the choices never stop: schools, screens, friends, rules, how much to protect and how much to let go. “If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God” (James 1:5), and I am asking. Show us what each of our children needs, and bring them up to know you. Amen.
45385.14.a: Prayers for Parents: For Your Mother and Father, and for Parents Raising Children

44512.16.t: Prayer for Wisdom and Godly Discernment
44512.16.x:
Heavenly Father, the source of all true wisdom, I pray for my son. Please fill him with a spirit of wisdom and discernment that goes beyond worldly knowledge. In every choice he faces today, help him to see situations, people, and opportunities through Your eyes.

Grant him the ability to recognize falsehood and to be drawn to what is righteous, pure, and true. Protect his heart from deceitful influences and give him the courage to reject counsel that does not align with Your Word. May he be slow to speak, quick to listen, and wise in his responses.

Lord, I pray he would value Your wisdom above all else, seeking it in Scripture and in prayer before making important decisions about his career, relationships, and finances. Let his life be a testament to the peace that comes from making wise, God-honoring choices, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
44512.16.a: Prayers for Your Adult Son: Protection, Work, Family and Faith

44611.1.t: Prayer for Wisdom and Godly Discernment
44611.1.x:
Lord, the Giver of all wisdom,

I pray for my daughter as she makes decisions, both big and small. Please fill her with a spirit of wisdom and discernment that can only come from You. When she is faced with a choice, quiet her heart so she can hear Your gentle guidance. Help her to see past surface-level appearances and to understand the deeper truths of any situation.

Protect her from deception and from making impulsive choices based on fleeting emotions. Give her the courage to choose the right path, even when it is the harder path. Surround her with wise, godly friends and mentors who will offer sound advice and point her back to You.

May her mind be clear, her judgment sound, and her motives pure. Help her to build a life on the rock of Your wisdom, not the shifting sands of worldly opinion. I pray she would trust in You with all her heart and lean not on her own understanding, In Jesus’ Name, Amen.
44611.1.a: 12 Prayers For Adult Daughter: Simple & Powerful

2279.23.t: Prayer for Guidance and Direction in Your Son's Life
2279.23.x:
Heavenly Father,

In Your infinite wisdom, You guide the stars and set the course of the rivers. Today, I entrust my son into Your loving hands, seeking Your divine guidance and direction over his life. Like a shepherd leads his flock, guide him on paths of righteousness, through valleys and atop mountains, ensuring each step he takes is firmly planted in Your purpose.

Grant him the light of discernment, that he may see Your will as a lantern in the darkness, illuminating his decisions. May Your voice be the compass in his heart, leading him towards actions that reflect Your love and grace. Protect him from the snares of temptation, and when he faces the crossroads of life, remind him that with You, he is never lost.

Bless him with courage to follow Your way, even when the world beckons him down easier paths of immediate gratification. Let the echo of Your wisdom resonate within him, crafting his journey into a testament of Your unending love and mercy. Amen.
2279.23.a: Prayers for Your Son at Every Stage of His Life

44512.9.t: When the two of you are not speaking
44512.9.x: Lord, my son and I are estranged. Show me my own part in it and give me the courage to own it. Soften both our hearts. Do in our family what you promised through the prophet: “he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers” (Malachi 4:6). Amen.
44512.9.a: Prayers for Your Adult Son: Protection, Work, Family and Faith

45387.11.t: Prayer for a Restored and Loving Relationship
45387.11.x:
Father of reconciliation, my heart aches for the distance that has grown between my son and me. The tension and misunderstanding have created a wall that I don't know how to break down on my own. I ask You to step into our relationship and bring healing.

Please soften both of our hearts. Give me the humility to see my own faults and to ask for forgiveness where I have failed him. Give him a heart that is willing to forgive and to let go of past hurts. Help us to communicate with grace and listen with true understanding, instead of just waiting to react.

Rebuild the trust that has been broken. Remind us of the love that is at the foundation of our family. May our home become a place of safety, acceptance, and grace, not a battlefield of wills. I long to enjoy my son again, Lord. Please restore the joy and connection we once shared, In Jesus’ Name, Amen.
45387.11.a: 12 Prayers For Struggling Son: Simple & Powerful

2060.9.x: Father, our children did not choose this. Keep them from believing it is their fault. Give them two parents who will not speak against each other in front of them, and let them feel loved in both houses. Where we fail them, send other people to stand by them: grandparents, teachers, a godparent, a youth leader. Amen.
2060.9.a: Prayers for Divorce: Saving a Marriage, Going Through It and Healing After

45341.13.t: When he will not talk to me
45341.13.x: Lord, my son has gone quiet. He shuts his door and answers in one word. Keep the way open between us. Help me listen more than I lecture, and let him know that he can always come to me. Amen.
45341.13.a: Prayers for a Teenage Son: School, Friends, Driving, Faith and the Parent Who Waits

45044.8.x: God, my son says nothing matters and nothing will change. You heal "the broken in heart" and bind "up their wounds" (Psalm 147:3). Reach him in that darkness. Keep him safe from himself, help him say yes to help, and give him one reason tonight to keep going. Amen.
45044.8.a: Prayers for a Troubled Son, and for the Parent Who Loves Him

45533.10.t: Prayer for a Hopeful Heart and a Vision for the Future
45533.10.x:
God of Hope, I come to You because my son’s heart has grown heavy with despair. The challenges he faces have clouded his vision, and he is struggling to see any light at the end of the tunnel. Discouragement is weighing him down and stealing his joy.

I pray that You would breathe new hope into his spirit. Please lift the veil of hopelessness from his eyes and help him to believe that good things are still ahead for him. Remind him of Your faithfulness and that his current struggles are not his final destination. Give him a fresh dream, a renewed purpose, and a sense of excitement for the future You have for him.

Fill him with a resilient and optimistic spirit that is rooted in Your promises, not in his circumstances. Let joy rise up in his heart, pushing out the sadness and fear. May he look forward with anticipation, knowing that You are with him and working all things for his good. In Jesus’ Name, Amen.
45533.10.a: 12 Prayers For Your Struggling Son: Simple & Powerful

45537.10.x: God, my son is sinking and I cannot pull him out. You are “nigh unto them that are of a broken heart” (Psalm 34:18). Keep him safe, keep him talking, and bring the right treatment and the right people into his life. Give me the patience to stay near without pushing. Amen.
45537.10.a: Prayers for Your Son's Health and Healing

2279.1.x: Father, my son walks into a classroom today without me. Give him a good teacher, one kind friend and the courage to ask when he does not understand. Let him grow as Jesus grew, “in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man” (Luke 2:52). Amen.
2279.1.a: Prayers for Your Son at Every Stage of His Life

1313.5.t: Prayer for Blessing and Dedication of the Child to God
1313.5.x:
Heavenly Father,

In Your infinite wisdom and love, You have blessed us with a precious new life. With hearts full of gratitude, we come before You today to dedicate our beloved child into Your eternal care. Like Hannah offered Samuel, we too offer our child back to You, Lord, as a living promise.

Bless this tender soul, O God, with Your grace and mercy. May Your love be a lamp to their feet and a light to their path as they grow and wander through this world. Grant them health, strength, and a heart that seeks after You. Encircle them with Your protection and peace, and guide them with Your wisdom.

May our child grow to be strong in spirit, kind in heart, and steadfast in faith. Help us, as their earthly guardians, to nurture their steps in Your ways, teaching them of Your love and righteousness. Let this dedication be the beginning of their journey towards fulfilling Your purpose and glory.

In Jesus' Name, we pray,

Amen.
1313.5.a: 12 Tender Prayers for Expectant Mothers and Their Little Ones

45478.9.x: Thank you, God, for this child and for bringing us both through. “Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward” (Psalm 127:3). Bless this little one all the days of life, and bring our child to baptism. Amen.
45478.9.a: Catholic Prayers for a Safe Delivery and a Healthy Baby

45341.10.x: Father, my son is looking for his first job. Open the right door for him, help him arrive on time and work honestly, and let him learn the pride of money earned by his own hands. Amen.
45341.10.a: Prayers for a Teenage Son: School, Friends, Driving, Faith and the Parent Who Waits

45049.17.t: A mother’s thanks when the baby is born
45049.17.x: Thank you, Lord, for my grandchild, and for bringing my daughter safely through. Give her rest and healing in the days ahead, and patience in the long nights. “Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD” (Psalm 127:3). Amen.
45049.17.a: Prayers for a Pregnant Daughter: A Mother's Prayers from the First Months to the Birth

45531.9.x: Thank you, Lord. My son has a job. Thank you for the door that opened, for the people who chose him, and for carrying him through the months of waiting. Let him remember where this came from on the hard days ahead. “In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you” (1 Thessalonians 5:18). Amen.
45531.9.a: Prayers for Your Son to Find a Job: From the Search to His First Week

2045.12.x: God, I cannot be with my daughter everywhere she goes. Keep her safe on the road, at night and among strangers. Give her the sense to notice danger and the nerve to walk away from it. "He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways" (Psalm 91:11). Amen.
2045.12.a: Prayers for a Daughter's Well-Being: Her Mind, Health, Safety and Faith

41989.11.x: Lord, I cannot follow my children everywhere they go. Keep them in body and soul, at school, on the road and online, and put wise people beside them when I am not there. “The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee” (Numbers 6:24–25). Amen.
41989.11.a: Prayers for Protection from Evil: Psalm 91, St Patrick's Breastplate and Short Prayers

43834.1.t: In the morning, for their safety
43834.1.x: Lord, my children are going out into the day, and I cannot go everywhere with them. Watch over them on the road, at school and wherever they play. Keep them from accidents and from people who would harm them, and bring them home safe tonight. “The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in” (Psalm 121:8). Amen.
43834.1.a: Prayers for Your Children, and Prayers Children Can Say

45491.7.t: Prayer for Safety When He Is Away
45491.7.x:
Lord, my heart feels a special vulnerability when my son is away from me. I release him into Your constant care, for You are with him even when I am not. I ask you to be his shield and defender wherever he goes.

Whether he is at school, on a trip, or simply out in the world, I pray for your hand of protection to be upon him. Keep him safe on the roads, protect him from those who might wish him harm, and guard him against unforeseen accidents or dangers.

Give him the courage to make wise choices, even when he is not under my roof. Let him feel Your presence near, and may that be a comfort to him and a deterrent to evil. I trust You, Lord, to watch over his coming and his going, both now and forevermore. Bring him home safely, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45491.7.a: 12 Prayers For Your Son's Safety: Simple & Powerful

2424.4.x: Lord, this morning I bring you my wife’s body and her health. Heal what is sick in her, ease her pain, and guide the doctors who treat her. Give her patience with slow recovery, and give me patience and gentleness while I care for her. “Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed” (Jeremiah 17:14): I ask this for her. Amen.
2424.4.a: Prayers to Lift Your Wife's Spirits, with Blessings for Her

43869.4.x: Lord, my husband is sick, and I cannot make him well. Give his doctors skill and the right answers, make the treatment work, and ease his pain. Give him patience with a body that will not hurry, and give me patience with him. Amen.
43869.4.a: Prayers for Your Husband: His Health, Safety, Work, Faith and Hard Times

45027.15.x: God, my husband is not well, and he will not always admit it. Give him the sense to see a doctor and the patience to follow the advice. Heal him, if it is your will, and give me wisdom in caring for him. Amen.
45027.15.a: Prayers for Men: For Strength, Work and Family, and for the Men You Love

45389.23.t: Prayer for Strength During Health Challenges
45389.23.x:
Lord of all Comfort, I lift my husband up to you as he navigates this difficult health journey. It is a heavy cross to bear, and I ask that You would infuse him with a strength that is not his own. When his body is weak and his spirit is tired, please be his strength.

Grant him courage for every doctor's appointment, every treatment, and every moment of uncertainty. Help him to not lose hope but to fix his eyes on You, the author and perfecter of our faith. Remind him that even in this trial, You are with him, You have not forgotten him, and You are working all things for his good.

Surround him with Your tangible peace and let him feel Your arms carrying him. Give our family the grace to support him well and to trust You completely through this valley. Let this challenge refine his faith and draw him closer to Your heart, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45389.23.a: Prayers for Your Husband's Health: Short Prayers and Orthodox Prayers for Healing

45505.24.t: Prayer for Comfort in Times of Grief
45505.24.x:
God of all Comfort,

My heart aches for my friend who is walking through the deep valley of grief. Their loss is immense, and their sorrow is profound. I ask that You would draw especially near to them right now. Be the comfort that no human word can provide.

Please wrap Your loving arms around them and hold them close. Let them feel Your presence as a tangible peace that settles over their chaotic emotions. Catch every tear they cry and soothe the raw ache in their soul. When they feel utterly alone in their sadness, please remind them that You are the God who sees them and weeps with them.

Give them strength for each moment of each day. Protect them from despair and instead, plant a small seed of hope deep within them—a hope that promises that joy will come in the morning, even if the night feels impossibly long. In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45505.24.a: Prayers for Someone: Short Prayers for a Friend, a Loved One or Anyone in Need

3465.13.x: God of all comfort, someone I love has died, and I do not know how to go on. Stay close to me in the empty hours. Help me through today, and give me people who will sit with me. Amen.
3465.13.a: Prayers for Help in Time of Need: From the Bible and the Prayer Books

45467.7.x: Father, someone I love is gone, and the world feels empty. I do not understand why. Stay close to me. “The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart” (Psalm 34:18). Carry me through the days I cannot face. Amen.
45467.7.a: Prayers for Trusting God in Hard Times, with the Daily Prayer of Philaret of Moscow

45393.5.x: Father, this family has lost someone they cannot replace. Be their strength in the days of arrangements and visitors, and in the quiet weeks after, when the visitors have gone home. Keep them patient with one another, and send friends who will help without being asked. Your word says, “Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted” (Matthew 5:4). Comfort them. Amen.
45393.5.a: Prayers for a Funeral: Opening, Committal and Closing Prayers for the Service

45389.6.t: When the worry is in his mind
45389.6.x: Father, my husband carries more than his body shows: fear about work, money and what comes next. Lift the worry he will not talk about. Let him cast “all your care upon him; for he careth for you” (1 Peter 5:7), and let him speak to me or to a doctor when the weight is too much. Amen.
45389.6.a: Prayers for Your Husband's Health: Short Prayers and Orthodox Prayers for Healing

43842.4.t: When she is worried or troubled in mind
43842.4.x: God, my wife is carrying worries she cannot put down, and some of them she has not told me. Quiet her mind, give her sleep, and let your peace keep her heart. Help me to listen more than I talk. Amen.
43842.4.a: Prayers for Your Wife: Daily Prayers and Prayers From the Wedding Service

43869.8.x: God, my husband is in trouble, and I do not know how it will end. Give him honesty and a clear head, send him people who will help him, and show us both the next right step. "God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble" (Psalm 46:1). Amen.
43869.8.a: Prayers for Your Husband: His Health, Safety, Work, Faith and Hard Times

45539.2.t: Prayer for Her Peace and Rest
45539.2.x:
Lord Jesus, You are the Prince of Peace. I bring my wife to You and ask that you would cover her with a peace that surpasses all understanding. You see the worries that weigh on her mind and the anxieties that try to settle in her heart. I rebuke those fears in Your name.

Please calm the storms within her. When her thoughts are racing, help her to fix her mind on You. I pray that our home would be a sanctuary of peace for her, a place where she can truly rest and recharge. Release her from the pressure to do everything and be everything for everyone.

Remind her that it is safe to rest in Your care. Let her feel Your comforting presence surrounding her like a warm blanket, soothing her soul and giving her the deep, restorative rest she needs. May she truly know the rest you offer to all who are weary and burdened, In Jesus’ Name, Amen.
45539.2.a: 12 Prayers For A Wife: Simple & Powerful

1568.8.x: God, our money is short, and my husband carries the weight of it. Give him steady work and fair pay. Give both of us wisdom with what we have, and keep the worry from turning us against each other. “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God” (Philippians 4:6). Amen.
1568.8.a: Prayers for Your Husband's Work: A Job, an Interview, a Hard Day and His Safety

43869.10.t: When he has lost his job
43869.10.x: Father, my husband has lost his job, and he feels he has let us down. Remind him that his worth does not depend on his paycheck. Open the right door soon, give him courage for every application and interview, and provide for our family while we wait. Amen.
43869.10.a: Prayers for Your Husband: His Health, Safety, Work, Faith and Hard Times

44726.8.x: Lord, my wife gives so much of herself at work and at home. Give her rest where she can take it, respect from those she works with, and success in what she sets out to do. Guard her from people who would take advantage of her, and let her know that her work is seen. Amen.
44726.8.a: Prayers for Success at Work: Before Work, for a Husband or Son, and for Hard Days

1568.2.t: When things are going badly at work
1568.2.x: Father, things are not going well for my husband at work. You see what happens there better than he can tell me. Settle what can be settled with his boss and the people around him. Give him a calm answer when he is provoked, since “a soft answer turneth away wrath” (Proverbs 15:1), and show him honestly where he is at fault and where he is not. Amen.
1568.2.a: Prayers for Your Husband's Work: A Job, an Interview, a Hard Day and His Safety

43869.12.x: God, my husband has a decision to make, and he cannot see the way ahead. Your word says, "If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him" (James 1:5). Give him that wisdom, and help us decide together. Amen.
43869.12.a: Prayers for Your Husband: His Health, Safety, Work, Faith and Hard Times

1568.9.t: Before a promotion or a big decision
1568.9.x: Lord, my husband has a choice to make about his work: a new position, an offer or a change. You give wisdom “to all men liberally” (James 1:5), so give him some now. If this step is right, open it and bless it. If it is not, close the door plainly. Amen.
1568.9.a: Prayers for Your Husband's Work: A Job, an Interview, a Hard Day and His Safety

45539.1.t: Prayer for Her Wisdom and Discernment
45539.1.x:
Lord God of all wisdom, I pray for my wife today. I ask that you would bless her with a sharp and discerning mind. In a world filled with confusing messages and conflicting opinions, please give her clarity to see things as you see them.

Quiet the noise of the world so she can hear Your still, small voice guiding her. When she faces a choice, whether it concerns our family, her work, or her own heart, I pray she would be filled with a wisdom that is pure, peace-loving, and gentle.

Protect her from deception and help her to recognize truth. Give her insight into people and situations, allowing her to make choices that honor You and bless those around her. May her decisions be rooted not in fear or worldly pressure, but in a confident trust in Your direction for her life, In Jesus’ Name, Amen.
45539.1.a: 12 Prayers For A Wife: Simple & Powerful

2613.5.t: When your spouse’s heart has turned cold
2613.5.x: Lord, my husband is distant, angry or no longer interested in our marriage, and nothing I say reaches him. Your word says, “The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will” (Proverbs 21:1). Turn his heart back toward you and toward home, and keep mine from turning bitter while I wait. Amen.
2613.5.a: Prayers to Restore a Marriage: After Fighting, Betrayal or Separation

2060.3.t: When my husband or wife wants to leave
2060.3.x: God, my husband (my wife) says it is over, and I do not want it to be. I cannot make anyone stay. Soften the heart that has turned away, and show me what I have done to hurt this marriage, so that I can change it whether or not we stay together. Give me the grace to fight for my marriage without begging or threatening. Amen.
2060.3.a: Prayers for Divorce: Saving a Marriage, Going Through It and Healing After

44660.2.t: When we fight all the time
44660.2.x: Lord, my husband (my wife) and I cannot talk without arguing. Show me my own part in it, and stop me before I say the thing that wounds. “A soft answer turneth away wrath” (Proverbs 15:1): put soft answers in my mouth, and give us one calm conversation this week. Amen.
44660.2.a: Prayers for a Marriage Under Attack: Spiritual Warfare, Fighting and Temptation

45529.11.t: Prayer for a Softened Heart in My Spouse
45529.11.x:
Lord, the great physician of hearts,

I feel like I am trying to work with a heart of stone. My spouse seems closed off, distant, and unwilling to change. My words and efforts seem to bounce right off. Lord, I know that I cannot change their heart, but I believe that You can. You are the only one who can perform this kind of heart surgery.

So I lift my spouse up to You right now. I ask You to pour out Your spirit upon them. Please, Father, soften their heart. Break down the walls of pride, anger, and bitterness they have built up. Help them to feel safe enough to be vulnerable again.

Create in them a new desire for peace and reconciliation. Turn their heart of stone into a heart of flesh, a heart that is tender toward You and toward me. I place them in your capable hands, trusting in Your power to move, in Jesus’ Name, Amen.
45529.11.a: 12 Prayers For Broken Marriage: Simple & Powerful

2424.2.x: Jesus, you said, “Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest” (Matthew 11:28). My wife is exhausted from the work, the children, the worry and everything no one sees her do. Give her rest, and show me what I can carry so that she can put something down. Amen.
2424.2.a: Prayers to Lift Your Wife's Spirits, with Blessings for Her

43842.21.t: Prayer for Her Joy and Happiness
43842.21.x:
Father in Heaven,

I come to You with a heartfelt desire for my wife's joy and happiness. Lord, You are the giver of all good gifts, and true joy is found in Your presence. I ask that You would pour out Your joy upon her, a joy that is deep, abiding, and not dependent on circumstances.

Help her to see the beauty in everyday moments, to find reasons to smile, and to feel a lightness in her spirit. Protect her from discouragement and fill any empty places in her heart with Your love and gladness. May laughter be a frequent sound in her life and in our home.

Guide her to find contentment in You, Lord, knowing that true happiness flows from a relationship with You. May her heart overflow with the joy that comes from Your salvation and the hope we have in Christ. Let her radiate this joy to others.

Thank You for being a God of joy.

In Jesus' Name, Amen.
43842.21.a: Prayers for Your Wife: Daily Prayers and Prayers From the Wedding Service

43869.34.x:
Father of all Joy,

I come to You today to ask for a fresh outpouring of Your joy into my husband's heart. Life can be challenging, and burdens can weigh him down. Please lift his spirits and fill him with the joy that comes only from You – a joy that is his strength.

Help him to find reasons to rejoice in You each day. Remind him of Your goodness, Your love, and Your many blessings in his life. May Your presence bring him fullness of joy. Protect him from discouragement, negativity, and a spirit of heaviness.

Let laughter fill our home, and may a cheerful heart be his medicine. Help him to see the good in every situation and to maintain a hopeful outlook. As he walks with You, may Your joy radiate from him, touching those around him and drawing them closer to You.

May the joy of the Lord be his constant companion.

In Jesus' Name, Amen.
43869.34.a: Prayers for Your Husband: His Health, Safety, Work, Faith and Hard Times

45389.20.x:
Heavenly Father, I pray for my husband's emotional health. Life is full of ups and downs, and I ask that You would give him a resilient spirit. Grant him the strength to navigate feelings of stress, disappointment, or sadness without being overcome by them.

Lord, be the anchor for his soul. When the waves of emotion feel high, help him to stand firm on Your truth. Teach him to bring his hurts and frustrations to You, finding a safe place to process them. Heal any old emotional wounds that may still affect him.

Fill him with a deep, abiding joy that is not dependent on his circumstances. Help him to find his worth and security in You alone, so that the opinions of others or the struggles of a day cannot shake him. Build in him a heart that is both strong and tender, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45389.20.a: Prayers for Your Husband's Health: Short Prayers and Orthodox Prayers for Healing

45333.27.x:
Heavenly Father, thank You for the gift of my friend, even though we are now separated by miles. I miss their presence, their laughter, and our everyday moments together. It is hard to be apart, but I pray against the distance that tries to weaken our bond.

I ask that you would bless our communication. Help us to be intentional about reaching out through calls, texts, and letters. Give us meaningful conversations that keep us connected to each other's lives, struggles, and joys. Remind us to pray for one another often, bridging the distance through our connection to You.

Please watch over my friend. Keep them safe, provide for them, and help them to find a wonderful community where they are. May our friendship not fade with the distance, but may it deepen through our commitment and creativity. Thank you that there is no distance in prayer and that our hearts can remain close. In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45333.27.a: Prayers for a Friend and for Friendship: A Friend in Need, a Broken Friendship and Thanks

2424.11.t: A husband’s thanksgiving for his wife
2424.11.x: Thank you, Lord, for my wife: for her kindness, her strength, her laughter and the thousand things she does for our family. “Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD” (Proverbs 18:22). I did find a good thing. Help me to tell her so, as the husband in Proverbs “praiseth her” (Proverbs 31:28). Amen.
2424.11.a: Prayers to Lift Your Wife's Spirits, with Blessings for Her

43842.2.t: A prayer of thanks for her
43842.2.x: Father, thank you for my wife. Thank you for her kindness, her laugh, the way she carries more than anyone sees, and the years you have given us. “Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD” (Proverbs 18:22). I have found that good thing. Help me never to take her for granted. Amen.
43842.2.a: Prayers for Your Wife: Daily Prayers and Prayers From the Wedding Service

1568.10.x: Thank you, Lord, for my husband's job: for the pay that feeds us, the skill you gave him and the people he works beside. Keep him thankful for it, and keep me thankful for him. Amen.
1568.10.a: Prayers for Your Husband's Work: A Job, an Interview, a Hard Day and His Safety

1568.5.x: Lord, my husband's work carries danger: on the road, on the site, on patrol or wherever he is today. Keep him alert, keep his equipment sound and the people beside him careful, and bring him home to us tonight. “The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore” (Psalm 121:8). Amen.
1568.5.a: Prayers for Your Husband's Work: A Job, an Interview, a Hard Day and His Safety

43869.7.t: When he is on the road
43869.7.x: Lord, my husband is traveling today. Keep him alert at the wheel and keep other drivers careful. Watch over him in every place he stops and every place he sleeps, and bring him home to us safe. Amen.
43869.7.a: Prayers for Your Husband: His Health, Safety, Work, Faith and Hard Times

45539.5.t: Prayer for Her Protection and Safety
45539.5.x:
Almighty God, my Fortress and my Shield, I place my wife into Your loving and powerful hands for protection. I ask that you would place your angels around her to guard her in all her ways. Keep her safe from accidents, sickness, and any physical harm as she goes about her day.

I also pray for her spiritual protection. Shield her heart and mind from the lies of the enemy. Guard her from temptation, discouragement, and fear. Do not allow any weapon formed against her to prosper. Let her feel safe and secure, not because the world is safe, but because You are her ultimate Protector.

Cover her with Your faithfulness as with a shield. Be her refuge when she feels vulnerable and her stronghold when she feels attacked. May she walk in confidence, fully aware that she is protected by the King of all kings and the Lord of all lords, In Jesus’ Name, Amen.
45539.5.a: 12 Prayers For A Wife: Simple & Powerful

43869.6.x: Lord, put your hedge around my husband today: around his body, his mind and his faith. Keep him from accidents and from people who would do him harm, and keep him from the temptations that would pull him away from you and from me. "The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in" (Psalm 121:8). Keep that promise for him. Amen.
43869.6.a: Prayers for Your Husband: His Health, Safety, Work, Faith and Hard Times

45354.16.x: Lord, the doctors have told us what is wrong with my mother, and we are frightened. Give her courage for the treatment ahead, skill and care to everyone who treats her, and the right answers at the right time. Whatever comes, do not let her face it alone. Amen.
45354.16.a: Prayers for My Mother: Blessing, Health and Protection

44502.2.x: Lord, my dad is ill, and he hates being looked after. Give him patience with the doctors and with us, let the treatment work, and restore him to health if it is your will. Give me the words and the time to help him. Amen.
44502.2.a: Prayers for Your Dad: His Health, His Work, His Faith and Hard Seasons

3405.4.t: For strength in a long illness
3405.4.x: Father, my dad has been sick a long time and he is tired of it. Give him patience with slow progress and with the people helping him. When his body is weak, be his strength, as the psalmist said: “My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever” (Psalm 73:26). Amen.
3405.4.a: Prayers for a Sick Father, at Home or in the Hospital

45385.1.x: Lord, keep my parents well. Guard them from illness and accidents, give them sleep at night and strength in the day, and guide their doctors when they need care. Where they are already unwell, ease the pain and restore their health, if it is your will. Amen.
45385.1.a: Prayers for Parents: For Your Mother and Father, and for Parents Raising Children

45354.23.x: God, thank you for my mother: for her love, her work, her faith, and all the ordinary days she gave us. Thank you for what she taught me that I still carry. Comfort everyone who misses her, and keep us in the hope of the resurrection. Amen.
45354.23.a: Prayers for My Mother: Blessing, Health and Protection

3018.6.x:
Heavenly Father,

In the hollowness left by the loss of my father, I seek Thy face. As a thirsty wanderer in the desert craves water, my heart thirsts for Hope. Amid these waves of sorrow, be my anchor, Lord. Guide me towards the shore of peace, delivering me from this storm of despair.

Your word says that Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted. In the shadow of this promise, I find solace. Help me to understand Your perfect plan even in this pain. Like the dawn piercing the darkest night, let hope spring anew within me, allowing me to see Your love and compassion in my grief.

In Jesus' name, I pray, Amen.
3018.6.a: In Loving Remembrance: Prayers for Solace After Losing a Father

44738.3.t: Prayer for Gratitude for His Life
44738.3.x: Lord, thank you for shaping me through him and for the legacy of love he left behind. Let my gratitude be a light that pushes back against the darkness of grief. I am forever thankful for the man You placed in my life to be my dad. In Jesus' Name, Amen.
44738.3.a: 12 Prayers For Loss Of Father: Simple & Powerful

45080.15.x:
O Lord, my Comforter, today my heart feels the weight of my mother’s absence. The calendar reminds me of what I have lost, and a wave of grief washes over me. I come before You with an honest heart, admitting that it still hurts deeply.

Please, wrap Your loving arms around me today. Be my strength when I feel weak and my peace when my thoughts are troubled. Your Word promises, "Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted" (Matthew 5:4). I hold onto that promise today, Lord. I ask for that blessing of comfort right now.

Let me feel Your presence in a real way. Quiet my anxious heart and soothe my aching soul. Help me to navigate this day not with despair, but with the gentle assurance that You are with me in my sorrow, carrying me through the pain and reminding me that I am never alone, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45080.15.a: Prayers for the Death Anniversary of a Mother

44502.5.x: God, my dad is slowing down. He forgets things and tires quickly, and it frightens both of us. Keep his mind clear as long as you can, keep him from falls, and keep him from feeling like a burden. The psalmist prayed, “Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not” (Psalm 71:18). Answer that prayer for my dad. Amen.
44502.5.a: Prayers for Your Dad: His Health, His Work, His Faith and Hard Seasons

2955.2.t: For Faith and Hope in Difficult Times
2955.2.x:
Heavenly Father,

We come before you today with heavy hearts. Our earthly father lies sick in the hospital, a terrain of uncertainty. We pray earnestly, Lord, for his healing. But simultaneously, we pray for faith and hope in these trying times. Let our fear be replaced with trust, our tears with hope.

Like the shepherd who guides his sheep through dark valleys, guide us now, Lord. Instill in us the faith to know that even in the hospital bed, You are there. Even in the pain, Your love remains unwavering.

May we feel Your divine presence, bringing tranquility amid chaos, trust amidst doubt, hope against despair. In our weakness, may we find strength in You, oh God. Grant our father the healing he needs, both in body and spirit. In Jesus’ name, we pray. Amen.
2955.2.a: Powerful Healing Prayers for a Father in the Hospital

44637.6.t: Prayer for His Emotional and Mental Well-being
44637.6.x:
God of all Comfort,

You see the parts of my dad's heart that no one else does. You know the worries he carries, the fears he doesn't speak of, and the emotional weight on his shoulders. Lord, I pray for his complete emotional and mental well-being. Please guard his mind from anxiety and his heart from discouragement.

Bring Your healing touch to any hidden wounds or silent struggles he may be facing. Replace his worries with Your deep and abiding peace that surpasses all understanding. Help him to know it is a sign of strength, not weakness, to bring his burdens to You and to trusted people around him. Let him feel seen, valued, and understood by You. Lift any spirit of heaviness and clothe him instead with a garment of praise and a peaceful, resilient mind. In Jesus’ Name, Amen.

44502.6.t: For his work and the pressure of money
44502.6.x: Lord, my dad carries more worry about money than he lets us see. Bless the work of his hands, give him fair employers and honest customers, and lift the weight of bills he cannot pay. Help him rest on Sunday without feeling guilty, and remind him that you are the one who provides. Amen.
44502.6.a: Prayers for Your Dad: His Health, His Work, His Faith and Hard Seasons

45354.12.x: God who provides, my mother is worried about money. Meet her needs, bless the work of her hands, and give her wisdom with what she has. Take the fear out of the bills. Your word says, “my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus” (Philippians 4:19). Amen.
45354.12.a: Prayers for My Mother: Blessing, Health and Protection

44637.3.t: Prayer for His Work and Provision
44637.3.x:
Father God, Provider of all good things,

I bring my dad’s work before you. I thank you for the heart he has to provide for our family and for the labor of his hands. I pray that You would bless his work abundantly. Give him favor with his colleagues and supervisors, and grant him skill and creativity in his tasks. More than just a paycheck, I pray that he finds purpose and satisfaction in what he does each day.

Lord, please lift the heavy weight of financial pressure from his shoulders. Remind him that You are his ultimate provider, Jehovah Jireh. Protect him from workplace stress and anxiety, and guard his heart so that his job does not consume him. Help him to find a healthy balance between work and rest, so he can be fully present with his family. May he always see his work as an opportunity to reflect Your diligence and faithfulness. In Jesus’ Name, Amen.

45105.8.t: Prayer for God's Provision and Their Work
45105.8.x:
Lord, our great Provider, You own the cattle on a thousand hills. I lift up my parents' work and our family's finances to You. I thank you for their diligence and the way they provide for us. I ask that You would bless the work of their hands.

Please give them favor with their employers and coworkers. Grant them creativity, skill, and integrity in all they do. If they are facing financial stress, I pray that You would open the windows of heaven and provide for every single need according to Your glorious riches. Protect them from job insecurity and worry about the future.

Most of all, help them to find fulfillment in their work, knowing that they are using their gifts to serve You and our family. Remind them always to trust in You, not their own efforts, as their ultimate source of provision, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45105.8.a: 12 Prayers For Your Parents: Simple & Powerful

45354.7.t: For wisdom in a hard decision
45354.7.x: Lord, my mother has a decision to make, and she does not know which way to go. Clear her mind of fear and pressure, and show her the right path. You promised that if anyone lacks wisdom, “let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him” (James 1:5). Give her that wisdom now. Amen.
45354.7.a: Prayers for My Mother: Blessing, Health and Protection

44502.7.x: God, my dad has decisions to make that I cannot make for him. Give him clear thinking and good advice, and keep him from choosing in a hurry. “Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding” (Proverbs 3:5). Amen.
44502.7.a: Prayers for Your Dad: His Health, His Work, His Faith and Hard Seasons

45105.2.t: Prayer for Their Wisdom and Guidance
45105.2.x:
Father of Light, from whom all wisdom comes, I pray for my parents. Please bless them with Your heavenly wisdom as they navigate the complexities of life. In big decisions and small choices, I ask that You would make their paths clear.

Quiet the noise of the world and the voice of doubt, so they can clearly hear Your still, small voice guiding them. Give them discernment to know right from wrong and the courage to choose the right path, even when it’s difficult. I pray for wisdom in their finances, their relationships, and their work.

May their words be full of grace and their actions be full of integrity. Help them to lead our family with a loving and steady hand, guided by Your eternal truth. Let every decision they make bring glory to You and a blessing to our home, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45105.2.a: 12 Prayers For Your Parents: Simple & Powerful

45227.9.t: Prayer for Wisdom and Clarity in Decisions
45227.9.x:
God of all Wisdom, the path of healthcare is often filled with confusing choices and important decisions. We ask you to grant our parents, our family, and their medical team a special measure of your divine wisdom and clarity.

Please quiet the noise of conflicting opinions and confusing information. Give them a clear sense of direction for the steps ahead. Help them to understand their options fully and to discern the best path forward for treatment and care. Remove any confusion and bless them with unity and peace as they make these choices together.

Let every decision be bathed in prayer and guided by your Holy Spirit. We trust that you will lead them and that you will make their paths straight. Give them the confidence that they are making choices that align with your perfect will for their lives. We ask for your clear guidance, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45227.9.a: 12 Prayers For Parents Health: Simple & Powerful

45385.5.t: When your parents are fighting or separating
45385.5.x: Lord, my parents are angry with each other, and the house feels like a battlefield. Calm them, help them speak without cruelty, and heal what can be healed between them. Whatever they decide, keep me from taking sides in a way I will regret, and help me to love them both. Amen.
45385.5.a: Prayers for Parents: For Your Mother and Father, and for Parents Raising Children

44502.12.t: When things are hard between you and your dad
44502.12.x: Lord, my dad and I are not speaking the way we should. Some of it is his fault and some of it is mine. Take the pride out of both of us. Give me courage to call first, and give him a soft heart when I do. Amen.
44502.12.a: Prayers for Your Dad: His Health, His Work, His Faith and Hard Seasons

45105.7.t: Prayer for a Spirit of Forgiveness
45105.7.x:
Merciful Father, who has forgiven us so much, I pray for a spirit of forgiveness to fill our home. Please soften my heart and help me to freely forgive my parents for any hurt they may have caused, whether intentional or not.

I also ask that You would give my parents forgiving hearts. Help them to release any bitterness or resentment they may hold toward each other, toward me, or toward others who have wronged them. Do not let old wounds create division in our family. Remind us all of the incredible grace You have shown us through Jesus.

Let Your love flow through us, healing broken relationships and building bridges of understanding. May our family be known for its quickness to say, "I'm sorry," and its eagerness to say, "I forgive you," In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45105.7.a: 12 Prayers For Your Parents: Simple & Powerful

3461.16.t: When there is fighting at home
3461.16.x: Father, there is too much arguing in our house. Give my parents wisdom and patience, and help me and my brothers and sisters to be kind to each other. Forgive me for the times I made it worse, and teach me to control my tongue. “If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men” (Romans 12:18). Amen.
3461.16.a: Prayers for Young People: For Youth Groups, School, Confirmation and the Evening

45385.4.t: For parents who live far away
45385.4.x: God, I cannot drop by to see how my parents are. Be with them in the house I grew up in. Send them good neighbors and a friend to call on them, and remind me to phone more often than I do. Amen.
45385.4.a: Prayers for Parents: For Your Mother and Father, and for Parents Raising Children

45354.14.x: Lord, my mother is getting older, and she can no longer do what she once did. Keep her from loneliness and from fear of being a burden. Show me how to honor her now, with my time as well as my words. You promised, “even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you” (Isaiah 46:4). Carry her. Amen.
45354.14.a: Prayers for My Mother: Blessing, Health and Protection

45227.5.t: Prayer for Joy and Laughter in Daily Life
45227.5.x:
Lord of all Joy, we pray for more than just physical health for our parents; we pray for their happiness. In the midst of appointments, medications, and physical challenges, we ask you to fill their days with moments of joy and genuine laughter.

Help them to see the good things around them—a sunny day, a kind word, a favorite song. Bring people into their lives who lift their spirits and make them smile. Open their hearts to feel happiness and to not let their health struggles steal their ability to enjoy the simple blessings of life.

Remind them that laughter is truly good medicine for the soul. Release them from the heaviness that can settle in and replace it with a spirit of lightheartedness and contentment. Let the sound of their joy be a beautiful testimony to your goodness, even in difficult seasons. We ask you to fill their home and hearts with gladness, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45227.5.a: 12 Prayers For Parents Health: Simple & Powerful

45354.9.x: Creator God, my mother is more than the work she does for us. Now that her life is changing, show her the good work you still have for her, whether at home, at church, in a job or among her friends. “We are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works” (Ephesians 2:10). Let her walk in them with confidence. Amen.
45354.9.a: Prayers for My Mother: Blessing, Health and Protection

44502.16.t: A prayer of thanks for your dad
44502.16.x: Father in heaven, thank you for my dad. Thank you for the work he did so we could eat, for the jokes and the lectures, for the times he showed up when he was tired. Where he failed, forgive him, and help me forgive him too. Let him know today that he is loved. Amen.
44502.16.a: Prayers for Your Dad: His Health, His Work, His Faith and Hard Seasons

45385.7.x: God, thank you for my parents: for the meals, the rides, the late nights and the lessons I did not want at the time. Forgive me for what I took for granted. Bless them with joy in their later years, and let them see their children and grandchildren doing well. Amen.
45385.7.a: Prayers for Parents: For Your Mother and Father, and for Parents Raising Children

3405.9.x: Thank you, Lord, for the better report, the first meal he enjoyed, the first walk down the hall. Finish the healing you have begun in my father, and let him never forget who brought him through. “Bless the LORD, O my soul … who healeth all thy diseases” (Psalm 103:2–3). Amen.
3405.9.a: Prayers for a Sick Father, at Home or in the Hospital

45354.2.t: A prayer of blessing for my mother
45354.2.x: Father, bless my mother. Thank you for the years she has given to her family and for everything she taught me, including the things I only understood later. Give her health in body and peace in mind. Let her see the good she has done, and let her children rise up and call her blessed, as Proverbs 31:28 says. Keep her close to you all her days. Amen.
45354.2.a: Prayers for My Mother: Blessing, Health and Protection

44502.1.x: Father, watch over my dad on the road, at work and at home. Keep him from accidents and from people who would cheat or harm him. “The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore” (Psalm 121:8). Keep that promise for him. Amen.
44502.1.a: Prayers for Your Dad: His Health, His Work, His Faith and Hard Seasons

45354.6.x: Father, watch over my mother at home, at work and on the road. Keep her from accidents and from people who would harm her, and guard her heart from words that wound. Your word says, “he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways” (Psalm 91:11). Amen.
45354.6.a: Prayers for My Mother: Blessing, Health and Protection

45385.3.t: For their protection, and my brothers and sisters
45385.3.x: Lord, watch over my parents and my brothers and sisters wherever they are today: on the road, at work and at home. “He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways” (Psalm 91:11). Keep every one of us safe until we are together again. Amen.
45385.3.a: Prayers for Parents: For Your Mother and Father, and for Parents Raising Children

45105.10.t: Prayer for Their Protection and Safety
45105.10.x:
Almighty God, our Shield and Protector, I place my parents into Your loving care. I ask that You would watch over them and keep them safe from all harm, danger, and evil. Be a fortress around them.

When they are driving, I pray for traveling mercies. When they are at work, protect them from accidents. When they are at home, guard them from any threat. Protect their bodies, their minds, and their spirits from any attack of the enemy.

Calm their fears and give them a sense of security that comes from knowing You are with them. Let Your holy angels stand guard over them and our home. May they walk in confidence, fully aware that they are covered by Your divine protection wherever they go, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45105.10.a: 12 Prayers For Your Parents: Simple & Powerful

45453.2.x:
Almighty God, our Rock and Fortress,

I pray for my friend who is growing weary in this battle against sickness. Lord, their own strength is fading, so I ask that You would pour Your divine strength into them. Be their energy when they have none left. Be their courage when they feel like giving up.

Help them to endure this trial with grace and resilience. When the days feel long and the nights are difficult, remind them that You have not left their side. Uphold them with Your righteous right hand and carry them through the toughest moments. Renew their strength day by day, moment by moment, so they can face whatever comes.

Let them feel Your power working in their weakness, making them strong in You. Help them to persevere, not with gritted teeth, but with a heart that is sustained by the knowledge of Your unfailing love and support, In Jesus' Name, Amen.
45453.2.a: 12 Prayers For Sick Friend: Simple & Powerful
